justification: The only shared content is the presence of a highly schematic human figure — A has stick-like anthropomorphs (one holding a staff/weapon) among a fleet of boats with crew-stroke rows, while B is a single monumental frontal torso-figure with heavy brow, nose, ears and arms with hands laid on the belly. There is no shared scene, no shared relationship between elements, and A's linear multi-figure boat composition has nothing in common with B's isolated single-body image.
